## Summary

**SUBQ** (Sub Quick): Subtracts data from destination.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `Bn – data → Bn` |
| Syntax | `SUBQ #<data>,Bn` |
| Short | Subtracts data from destination. |
| Description | Subtracts an immediate value of one to eight from the destination. Destination is a B-addr register. Size is long. |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–12 | `0101` |
| 1 | 11–9 | Data |
| 1 | 8–3 | `100001` |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have SUBQ. This page covers only the 68080 addition: SUBQ with a B address register as destination. For the classic forms, the Motorola manual applies.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
